intro: Toolbox latches take drops, cold and the weight of stacked boxes, and a broken latch can sideline a good box. We print replacement latches and clips in PETG, or carbon-fibre nylon (PA-CF) for rough use, with the print oriented to the load. Products in this category: DeWalt TSTAK latch clip, Milwaukee Packout drawer latch and custom replacement part from a photo.
